Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an exemption from unemployment compensation for certain small performing arts industries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an exemption from unemployment compensation forcertain small performing arts industries; and adding a new section tochapter 50.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 50.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The term "employment" does not include any person engaged inactivities related to a performance sponsored by an employer with NorthAmerican industry classification system code 711110, 711120, or 712110,who receives no remuneration for these activities other than a nominalstipend. The stipend is presumed to defray the individual's incidentalexpenses involved in performing including, but not limited to, meals,transportation, lodging, costumes, supplies, child care, and relatedexpenses. This section does not apply to employers with more thanthree individuals in their employ during any portion of a day duringthe calendar year. For purposes of this section, "stipend" means a fixed sum of money p. 1 SSB 5534paid periodically to defray expenses.
